While roaming the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] foundling [[Taggor Bren]] encountered a '''woman''' who was wandering by herself. The woman spoke to Bren in his native [[Language/Legends|language]] which he had forgotten after some [[Time/Legends|time]]. Some short time afterwards, a group of three [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] offered Bren [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] in exchange for the woman, to which he agreed and the gangsters carried the woman off.<ref name="GalaxyMag" />

==Behind the scenes==
The woman whom Taggor Bren interacted with was mentioned in "[[Taggor Bren: One Dangerous Bounty Hunter]]," a starter story for the [[West End Games]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]], written by [[Bill Smith]] and published in the [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''<ref name="GalaxyMag" /> in [[October]] 1994.<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/6480|text=Star Wars Galaxy Magazine #1}}</ref>
